components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1c1e21; color: #f7f5f0; padding: 6px 24px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 3px; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5c842; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1c1e21; padding: 6px 24px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #dadde1; border-radius: 3px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #1c1e21; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5c842; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: 3-up feature/example cards used across 'Batteries: Included' and example-app grids.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 0px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 3px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,.1); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-card h4 { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 8px; }

components.name: Numbered Eyebrow
components.description: Signature bordered numeral badge prefixing section headings (01/02/03).
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #f5c842; color: #1c1e21; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Wasp's homepage reads as a developer-tool spec sheet, not a conventional SaaS marketing page: a cream/parchment ground, blocky sharp-edged panels, a monospace heading face, and literal code blocks used as proof rather than illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace headings paired with a humanist sans body

rules.name: The Three-Colors Rule
rules.body: Per the team's own design blog: "Three colors, and that's it." Wasp Yellow (#f5c842), Ink Black (#111), and Blueprint Paper (#f7f5f0) are the entire declared system; the violet accent and dark surface panel are shipped exceptions, not sanctioned brand colors.

rules.name: The Sharp-Corner Rule
rules.body: "90° angles, 2px strokes, no rounded-blob softness anywhere" — stated directly in the design blog. Live implementation mostly honors this (0px card radius) but ships 1px borders (not 2px) and a rounded-square logo/favicon corner (rx=300).

dos: Do treat #f5c842 (Wasp Yellow, confirmed by both the design blog and the favicon/logo) as the one true brand gold.
Do keep headings in a monospace face — load-bearing for the spec/terminal positioning; ship the declared JetBrains Mono rather than silently falling back to IBM Plex Mono only.
Do keep surfaces sharp-edged per the team's own 90°-angle law.
Do keep the theme light-first — the design blog states this is deliberate, not an oversight.
donts: Don't treat the violet accent or dark surface panel as core brand colors — neither is in the declared three-color system.
Don't introduce gradients — none exist anywhere in the current implementation.
Don't assume the shipped 1px border-width or the logo's rounded corner are the intended standard — the design blog declares 2px strokes and zero corner softness.
